pages.title: Stock your workshop
pages.text: Bring a stone pickaxe or better for Ariente ores.$(br2)Silver, Platinum, Lithium and Manganese ores drop $(thing)raw metal$(). Fortune increases the drops; Silk Touch keeps the ore block. Smelt or blast each raw metal or ore block into $(thing)one ingot$().

pages.title: Fuel and silicon
pages.text: Negarite and Posirite ores drop their blocks. Each yields $(thing)four dust$() when smelted or blasted.$(br2)Silicon Ore drops Silicon directly; Fortune helps, while Silk Touch keeps the ore.$(br2)The Smelter also accepts raw metals and ore blocks, with the same yields as a furnace.

pages.title: What to keep
pages.text: $(li)Silver: common machine parts.$(li)Platinum: construction and armor.$(li)Silicon: electronics.$(li)Lithium and Manganese: advanced components.$(li)Negarite and Posirite Dust: fuel and crafting.$(br2)Keep both fuel types. More of one never replaces the other. Blueprints and ingredients are separate requirements.
